findings.description: `saveBatch()` counts a photo as arriving only while its ID remains in `incoming`, although the receiver removes that entry before asynchronous hash verification finishes. If Save all is tapped while verification is pending, the photo is neither eligible nor counted as still arriving, so the page can say `Nothing new to save` despite that transfer still being processed.
findings.title: A verifying photo disappears from counts

findings.description: `createSaveAll.tap()` downloads entries from its original `ready` snapshot without checking whether `save(p)` handed one over during an inter-download wait. If someone taps a not-yet-downloaded photo while a laptop batch is running, the single-photo control downloads it immediately and the batch downloads it again when its turn arrives.
findings.title: A photo downloads twice during a batch
